executor: Git SHOW via subprocess; exact excerpt retention
entry:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib, json
root=Path('dreyeck/nested-actions/sources')
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
repo='/Users/rgb/workspace/wiki-plugin-mech-upstream'
rev='a028b4bba04e539dcaa090423d38a00a0050489d'
specs=[
 ('listen','src/client/blocks.js','function listen_emit(', '\nfunction message_emit('),
 ('report','src/client/blocks.js','function report_emit(', '\nfunction source_emit('),
 ('message','src/client/blocks.js','function message_emit(', '\nasync function solo_emit('),
 ('run','src/client/blocks.js','export async function run(', '\n// B L O C K S'),
 ('render','src/client/mech.js','function emit(', '\nfunction bind(')]
records=[]
for role,path,start,stop in specs:
    source=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',repo,'show',rev+':'+path]).decode()
    a=source.index(start); b=source.index(stop,a)
    excerpt=source[a:b].rstrip()+'\n'
    target=root/(role+'.js')
    target.write_text(excerpt)
    records.append(dict(role=role,status='source-observed',repository='https://github.com/WardCunningham/wiki-plugin-mech',
                        revision=rev,path=path,startLine=source[:a].count('\n')+1,
                        endLine=source[:b].count('\n'),file=str(target),
                        sha256=hashlib.sha256(excerpt.encode()).hexdigest(),
                        limitation='Retained public revision; not established as the newer nested Solo implementation.'))
producer="""const message = {
  action: 'publishSourceData',
  topic: 'node',
  title: props.title || props.name.replaceAll(/\\n/g,' ')
}
window.opener.postMessage(message)
"""
p=root/'ward-node-message.js'
p.write_text(producer)
records.insert(0,dict(role='producer',status='source-observed',origin='Ward-supplied fragment in the follow-up task',
                     revision=None,path=None,file=str(p),sha256=hashlib.sha256(producer.encode()).hexdigest(),
                     limitation='Supplied source; current runtime revision and complete click-handler installation not provided.'))
(root/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
license_text=Path(repo+'/LICENSE').read_text()
(root/'LICENSE-Mech').write_text(license_text)
print(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
expected: Retain immutable excerpts with provenance
observed: 6 source records, hashes and MIT notice retained
replan: Use exact producer and LISTEN source for native capture
